paging.threshold_justification: Idle Page Reads/sec is not cleanly zero (run_id=e6bae93f-998c-42c4-ac8c-6351cf389f57: idle fraction_above_zero=0.017241379310344827, median=0, p95=0, max=595.0385684165428; generation fraction_above_zero=0.2972972972972973, median=0, p95=5103.928244308032, max=5380.289546611703). Gate is baseline-relative: threshold = idle_p95 + margin = 0.0 + 1.0 = 1.0 page reads/sec, sustained for >=2 consecutive samples at sample_interval_s. Available-memory <500 MB invalidation unchanged. Canary and quiescence thresholds unchanged. Generation shows sustained runs above this threshold (finding recorded in the baseline summary); excluded blocks remain in records[] with reasons and are never silently dropped.

instrumentation_note: Per-repeat free_physical / peak_working_set / peak_commit / kv_bytes_expected / working_set_lock are on repeats.ndjson (memory_instrumentation). Peak working set reproduces across acceptance pairs; free_physical_at_peak does not — a ceiling is defined by the quantity that does not reproduce, recorded per repeat.

interactive_process_termination.note: resolve_isolation_mode / acceptance.ps1 refuse remote mode while interactive software is resident; the harness does not terminate those processes. If the operator killed processes outside the harness, that kill time is unobservable here — do not infer it.
